key_insight: StreamCacheVGGT replaces binary token eviction with a training-free cache manager that combines robust cross-layer scoring and hybrid compression, preserving critical information for stable, constant-memory streaming 3D reconstruction.
problem_solved: How to perform dense 3D geometry reconstruction from continuous video under a strict O(1) memory budget without destroying information via binary eviction or suffering noisy, single-layer scoring.
method: Cross-layer robust scoring: aggregate signals across transformer layers and time to produce stable token importance ranks and reduce evaluation noise.

Hybrid cache compression: instead of pure eviction, compress and summarize low-importance tokens (e.g., token aggregation and lightweight quantization/summary) to retain semantics within fixed memory.
Training-free, plug-in integration with Visual Geometry Transformers to enable streaming inference and improved temporal consistency for dense 3D reconstruction.
impact: Enables more accurate and stable streaming 3D reconstruction on memory-limited devices (robots, AR/VR, edge cameras) without retraining, reducing information loss and improving temporal consistency during long video streams.

paper_title: StreamCacheVGGT: Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers with Robust Scoring and Hybrid Cache Compression
paper_authors: Xuanyi Liu, Deyi Ji, Chunan Yu, Qi Zhu, Xuanfu Li
